text: After the death of her husband James, [who struck her when she asked for a divorce|wrong|cruelty at home], Harper Marlowe [takes a holiday alone in the Herefordshire village of Cotson|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. Near a disused railway tunnel she sees a naked man watching her, and soon [every man in the village wears the same face|threat|impostors and doubles]: her landlord Geoffrey, a policeman, a boy, and a vicar who says she is partly to blame. In the church, [the Green Man is carved on a font|images|plants, trees and fungus] beside a Sheela na gig.
